NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Albor asks for permission to save the share cards you create to your photo library.
NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Ads help keep Albor free. If you allow it, this identifier is used to show you more relevant ads. Albor works fully either way.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Albor asks for microphone access so you can record and play back stories aloud.
